messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1768400000 — elevated 5xxs from dedicated pool eu-2 (svc=redwood-inference, route=/v1/generate). error_rate=35% over last 2m, p95 latency spike. auto-runbook triggered

maria (oncall): seeing it. p95 up to 2.1s and a small cluster of timeouts. pulling logs now. tagging @jamal

jamal (sre): on it. checking infra metrics and connection pool. looks like kernel OOMs on 2 nodes, redis kv-cache errors coincident. starting node-restart play for eu-2-azb

maria (oncall): good. can we fail traffic to eu-1 as immediate mitigation? need to protect latency-sensitive enterprise routes (atlasix-bank, quiver-health, solara-pay)

jamal (sre): yes — initiating graceful routing shift for enterprise tier to eu-1 (sticky session fallback OFF for these routes). executing: `rb route set --dest eu-1 --selector "tier:enterprise,model:all" --reason "eu-2 degraded"`

ops-bot: command accepted. routing change in progress. estimated 45s to start draining connections.

maria (oncall): crafting status page + customer comms. Draft below — please review and approve. want to send Atlasix-specific alert ASAP (they have active credit-auth flow).

status-bot: DRAFT status page update (short):
```
Incident: Degraded inference availability in eu-dedicated-2
Status: Investigating / Partial mitigation in progress
Impact: Increased error rates and latency for Dedicated eu-2 serving. Some enterprise tenants may see timeouts or slower responses.
Mitigation: Traffic for enterprise tier is being routed to eu-1 as a temporary fallback. We are performing restarts and kernel memory tuning on affected hosts.
ETA: 30-60 minutes for full recovery, we will provide updates every 15 minutes.
```

leo (acct-exec): tagging Atlasix POC list: Alice Hayes (alice.hayes@atlasix.com), Rajiv Menon (ops: +44 7700 900900), Escalation: CTO Pager (pager: +1-415-555-0199). I can send the outbound note to them — want the tailored impact text.

tara (cs): please include this line for Atlasix: "Credit authorization latency may increase or fail for small subset (~1-2%) of requests routed through eu-2 during the window." Also mention that we are prioritizing queued real-time flows and that we can enable a dedicated fallback pool if they want zero-latency SLA (requires approval).

maria (oncall): suggested Atlasix notification (one-paragraph):
"Hi Atlasix team — we’re investigating degraded inference availability impacting our dedicated eu-2 serving tier. You may experience elevated latency and occasional timeouts for real-time credit authorization requests routed to eu-2. As a mitigation, we have temporarily shifted enterprise traffic to eu-1 and are performing node restarts and kernel memory tuning in eu-2. Our current ETA for full recovery is 30–60 minutes. We will notify you when traffic has been restored to normal. If you need a direct escalation channel or want us to enable a hot spare fallback pool, please reply here or reach out directly to your AE (Leo)."

leo (acct-exec): good. I will send now and put Rajiv on a call if they want. tina@atlasix ops isn't urgent; Rajiv will be primary. sending at 17:22 UTC.

jamal (sre): update on root cause investigation: observed repeated allocation failures inside our quantized kernel path under long sequences, exacerbated by a recent runtime kernel patch (deployed yesterday). rolling-restart applied to eu-2-azb nodes, patch reverted for azb for testing. monitoring memory and kv-cache health.

maria (oncall): mitigation status: routing shift completed for ~85% of enterprise sessions. eu-2 active connections draining. error rate dropped from 35% -> 6% in 6m. still seeing intermittent 5xx on ~2 nodes.

ops-bot: runbook step executed: `rb nodes restart --filter eu-2-azb --graceful` (3 nodes).

jamal (sre): next steps: continue restart, remove patched kernel from canary pool, run a controlled repro with internal traffic to validate kernel fix, then reintroduce nodes. if repro fails, we will cut a rollback and run a full cluster repro.

maria (oncall): handing off to jamal for night coverage at 17:30 UTC. jamal — you have current context, logs, and the draft customer comm recorded above. please post next public update and confirm when we can start shifting sessions back. tagging @leo for final external send confirmation.

jamal (sre): ack — taking over. will post update in 15m. leaving a note for oncall: `incident:eu-2-kernel-oom, mitigated by routing fallback, ongoing node restarts, possible kernel revert`

status-bot: PUBLIC UPDATE (to post):
```
Update 17:27 UTC — We have temporarily rerouted enterprise traffic from eu-dedicated-2 to eu-1 to mitigate increased error rates. Error rates have decreased significantly. Engineers are performing node restarts and evaluating a recent runtime patch. We expect restoration within 30–60 minutes and will provide another update by 17:45 UTC.
```

maria (oncall): quick checklist before handoff:
- leo to send Atlasix tailored email (done)
- tara to log support ticket and attach RCA stub (tara: pls confirm ticket#)
- jamal to continue restarts and post next status update

tara (cs): ticket created: #INC-2026-4389 — I attached log bundle and Atlasix POC info. will update thread after customer ack.

jamal (sre): 17:40 UTC update: error rate down to 1.2%. eu-2 node 4 still shows transient allocation spikes, removed from rotation. continuing to monitor at 1m resolution; if stable for 20m we will start shifting sessions back incrementally.

maria (oncall): thanks. if anything regresses wake me — I'm reachable via pager. great coordination.

leo (acct-exec): Atlasix replied acknowledging, appreciates quick routing shift. asked if we can provide per-route logs for 17:00–17:30 window; tara, can you attach to ticket?

tara (cs): attaching logs now to INC-2026-4389. noted for post-incident customer RCA.

jamal (sre): 17:57 UTC final update before close: metrics stable for 25m, error rate baseline restored. reintroducing eu-2 nodes with kernel rollback applied. will monitor for 30m then mark resolved if stable.

status-bot: RESOLVED (18:25 UTC):
```
Incident resolved — eu-dedicated-2 restored to normal operation. Root cause: kernel memory regression in a runtime patch causing allocation failures under certain seq-lengths. Mitigation: routing fallback to eu-1, node restarts, kernel rollback for affected hosts. Postmortem and customer-facing RCA to follow.
```

maria (oncall): incident closed. jamal — please own postmortem. include timeline, kernel patch diff, customer impact (Atlasix window + contacts), and follow-up actions: improved pre-deploy canary for kernel patches, update routing fallback automation to include enterprise sticky sessions.

jamal (sre): will do. creating PM doc and assigning timeline. closing thread.
